description: Discover pixel/app events or accessible tracking diagnostics for an advertiser. Uses best-effort endpoint checks plus reporting dimensions as fallback.

appId.description: Optional TikTok app ID for app event lookup when the endpoint is available.

bcId.description: Optional Business Center ID. Defaults to TIKTOK_BC_ID/TIKTOK_BUSINESS_CENTER_ID for BC pixel discovery.

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD for tracking diagnostics. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

pixelId.description: Optional pixel ID for pixel event lookup.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD for tracking diagnostics. Defaults to 7 days ago.

name: tiktok_get_events

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: tiktok get events
